claims.claim: Regression fixtures and documentation distinguish TASK-365's published Human AUTO feature from the omitted ingress consumer, preserving the supplied REVIEW and workflow/job incident anchors without inventing a RUN.

Ingress requires matching current Runtime preflight and Unified State before automatic executorless delivery; coding-required or unavailable authority produces an exact-subject Human-wakeup-needed Issue receipt.
Human manual and AUTO carriers retain their authenticated selection, model, effort and provenance forwarding through the existing wakeup path.

Automatic delivery is limited to Runtime-proved executorless NO_CHANGE or FINALIZE_CANDIDATE; authoring replay suppresses execution selectors and existing journal collision/replay enforcement remains intact.

Issue receipts and read-only consumers bind workflow attempts to validated origin pointers, expose GitHub job/step status, support exact direct-dispatch discovery and retrieve attributable job logs without publishing them.

Runtime's missing-Executor branch emits EXECUTOR_REQUIRED, final projection preserves stronger rejections, and failed transient receipts become operational failures with explicit unavailable diagnostics.
Self-host permissions remain contents-read-only; hosted outcomes reuse the Issue receipt writer, with existing repair journal, lock and CAS implementation unchanged.

Added focused integration and adversarial test cases covering authoring, Runtime preflight, Human manual/AUTO delivery, executorless completion, replay, provenance substitution and unavailable diagnostics.
